question: Can the accepted finite candidate integrate versioned hard evidence, paid selective feedback, actionable forecasts and structural repairs in executable DEVELOPMENT arms under a fully charged common contract, and what survives the strongest ordinary combination?
reliable_gain: Reconstruct and implement the accepted hard-state/forecast interface, actual-selector and receipt binding, immutable scoring, version withdrawal and resource-failure behavior with matched ordinary controls.
exploratory_gain: Develop an explicitly declared arithmetic/program family beyond the exhausted small modular table, admit exact/analytic/cache shortcuts, and test resource, edit, price and model-retention distinctions without asserting learning superiority.
likely_failure: Ordinary exact/cache/composed methods erase predictive gains; hard-answer integration can invalidate feedback predictability; stale warrants or hidden-label access may corrupt claims; tariffs or service mismatch can create false separation.
first_informative_check: Reconstruct both accepted hard-answer composition routes and identify existing implementation APIs; build a tiny deterministic broker witness with unchanged base purchases, sound paid correction, withdrawal and failed receipts before broad development runs.
evidence_criteria: Executable accepted candidate, proof/evaluation-only, ordinary probability-to-expected-cost, finite online mixture, ordinary structural/repair, charged exact comparator, free-oracle diagnostic and strongest credible ordinary combination as relevant to each arm.
Explicit deterministic query families and matched information, computation, feedback, storage, caching and reporting service contracts; public observations separated from evaluation-only truth.
Source-bound reproducible DEVELOPMENT comparisons, all failures and adverse results, including inherited exact-table obstruction.
Substantive hard-state, resource-failure and scope/version integration, with load-bearing independent same-model reconstruction.
All 21 duties and five primary questions reconciled with exact contribution delta and remaining scope.
Measured Research90 and append-only phase accounting; no final freeze/evaluation or automatic next-task activation.
concurrency_policy: Delegated same-model nonblind reconstructions and disjoint implementation tasks; overlapping agent time adds zero to principal credit.
boundary: Stop at P3-08; P3-09, options B/C and R-P3-N01 remain unselected.
